I've seen worse. You're going to live.
It's just a scratch. You'll be fine.
Let me reload. Just a moment.
Reloading. I can't heal right now.
Slow down. (putting Lúcio or Tracer to sleep)
Rest up, old man. (putting Reinhardt, Reaper, Soldier: 76 or Torbjörn to sleep)
Caught in my web. (putting Widowmaker to sleep)
Children of the sun need their sleep. (putting Illari to sleep while she is using Captive Sun)
I think justice could use a little nap. (putting Pharah to sleep while she is using Barrage)
Too eager, Reinhardt. (putting Reinhardt to sleep while he is using Charge)
Don't test my reflexes. (putting an enemy to sleep while they are using a movement ability)
You're so predictable... (putting an enemy to sleep while they are using a movement ability)
That's what "good" looks like. (putting an enemy to sleep while they are using a movement ability)
You're powered up! Get in there! (self and target)
I will not leave a broken world behind.
*sighs* A mother's work is never done...
Keep in sight. I'll have us in and out in no time.
Maybe one day, we'll go on missions in Hawaii.
Stay sharp! It's harder to keep you alive when you're distracted.
We must all find a cause worth fighting for.

I know you're determined to dive right in, but try to stay in my line of sight. (with at least four of Brigitte, D.Va, Doomfist, Genji, Lúcio, Tracer and Winston on the team; Venture and Wrecking Ball are mistakenly excluded)
Let's use our superior range against them. (with Hanzo, Widowmaker and Zenyatta on the team; Ashe and Sierra are mistakenly excluded)
Keep in sight, and this will go smoothly.
Stay focused. We have everything we need.
Let's do it again, from the top.
Not bad. Now, let's finish this.
They can try all they like. We won't falter.
They're going to throw everything they have at us. But it won't be enough.
Hold it together. We haven't lost yet.
Let's get it together. We are not losing this.
We can still turn this around. Everyone, focus.
Forget what happened in the past; we just have to win here.
This is the end. We must give it our all.
Win here and our jobs are done.
I go out on my terms.
I still have some fight in me.
*sighs* One of these days I'll end up in Fiji...
You'll have to try harder than that.
I still have a lot to do.
I must keep my skills sharp.
I'll make quick work of them.
The Eye of Horus watches over you!
I am ready for the challenge.
Someone needs to show how it's done.
When I was younger, we'd call this routine.
The enemy's attacking from the front.
Watch for enemies to our rear.
Their time is short. Hold strong!
Our time is up. Push now!
We move now, or not at all. Attack!
I'm securing the objective. Anyone want to join me?
Taking the point. Backup would be wonderful.
They're attacking the point. Stop them!
They're taking the objective. Focus our defenses!
We have enemies on the point. Lock it down!
We need to protect the objective.
Shall we move to the next objective?
We are en route to the next objective!
They're pushing the payload. Cut them off.
Get the payload on its way!
Not forgetting the payload, are we?
We can't move until the payload moves.
We'll take you where you need to go.
They've taken possession of the robot.
Don't let them push any further.
We need to put a stop to their push.
The lead is nearly ours. Keep pushing!
They'll have to try harder than that.
They're about to take the lead!
We can't let them push ahead of us!
Focus, everyone! Stay with the robot!
Stay on the robot if you want to win!
We're at the end! Don't leave the robot!
If we can drive them away, we can win!
Last chance to take the robot!
We must get the robot now!
Taking the flag back to base.
They've taken our flag! Get it back!
I can still get the job done.
I'm still one step ahead of the rest.
How did we let that happen?
That is not an acceptable outcome.
Age and beauty. I have you on both.
Experience always wins in the end.
Not the first. Not the last.
You can't teach an old dog new tricks. (Literal: Egyptian proverb - "Once his hair turned grey, they sent him to school.")
Don't make it easy for me, young man. (eliminating Baptiste or Cassidy)
You make all of Reinhardt's mistakes... (eliminating Brigitte)
Youth is wasted on the young. (eliminating D.Va, Lúcio, or Tracer)
You used to be better than this. (eliminating Emre or Freja)
No one to save you, Angela. (eliminating Mercy)
I don't even know you anymore. (eliminating Reaper)
*chuckles* I'll make it up to you, dear... (eliminating Reinhardt)
Settle down, old man. (eliminating Reinhardt, Sigma, Soldier: 76, or Torbjörn)
Is that enough fun for you? (eliminating Shion)
You still have much to learn. (eliminating Sojourn)
Sorry, Winston. You're a big target! (eliminating Winston)
Long-range takedown confirmed. (eliminating an enemy at long range)
Not even my longest shot this week. (eliminating an enemy at long range)
Whoever stole my technology does not know how to use it. (eliminating a Nano-Boosted enemy)
You can't use my tricks against me. (eliminating a Nano-Boosted enemy)
Wow, that really is helpful. (eliminating an enemy while Nano-Boosted)
I, of all people, should know how to stop that. (eliminating a Nano-Boosted Genji while he is using Dragonblade)
What did I teach you about safe barrages? (eliminating Pharah while she is using Barrage)
We all saw that coming, Gabriel... (eliminating Reaper while he is using Death Blossom)
Remember, Reinhardt... when you charge, your shield is down. (eliminating Reinhardt while he is using Charge)
You think I've never fought an invisible person before? (eliminating Sombra while she is using Stealth)
No hesitation this time. (eliminating Widowmaker at long range)
I grew tired of fighting alone.
Making an old woman do all the work?
No shortage of work to do.
Underestimate me at your own peril.
*chuckles* You'll need more than that to bring me down.
I'm still a threat up close.
You want another dance so badly? (eliminating Reinhardt)
Falling is easy. Getting back up is the challenge.
I like to confirm my kills... but this is more fun.
It's good to have backup again.
Keep that up and maybe I will retire.
Trying to impress me, young man? (after Baptiste or Cassidy eliminates an enemy)
Thank goodness someone taught you to shoot. (after Cassidy eliminates an enemy)
Well struck, archer! (after Hanzo eliminates an enemy)
"Clever like the fox." (after Kiriko eliminates an enemy)
I knew you had a mean streak, Angela. (after Mercy eliminates an enemy)
Like mother, like daughter. (after Pharah eliminates an enemy)
That's my daughter. (after Pharah eliminates an enemy)
*in Arabic:* Like mother, like daughter. (after Pharah eliminates an enemy)
Don't you miss watching my back, Gabriel? (after Reaper eliminates an enemy)
My knight in shining armor. (after Reinhardt eliminates an enemy)
Reinhardt, you haven't lost a step! (after Reinhardt eliminates an enemy)
Clean work as always, Vivian. (after Sojourn eliminates an enemy)
Nice shooting, Jack. (after Soldier: 76 eliminates an enemy)
You always did watch my back, Torbjörn. (after Torbjörn eliminates an enemy)
Nano boost is ready to deploy.
My ultimate is fully charged. Get in there!
My ultimate is ready. Get in there and I will boost you!
Nano boost is ready. Get in there and I'll hit you!
Moving to attack! Follow me in.
We need to fall back and regroup.
Focus our attack on the objective!
We need to move the payload!
It takes a woman to know it.
Need someone to tuck you in?
High tech, low tech... we all die, in the end.
Call me "cyclops" again, and see what happens.
This is much better than retirement.
More lost than the moon in winter.
Lucky for you, we're not keeping score.
Follow me, if you want to live.
You need to learn to relax.
In the desert, the cheetah lives for 3 years, and the camel lives for 9.
They say you're a good shot. Hope you don't mind that I'm better.
I know more than anyone that a head that big is an easy target.
Why the hell'd you give B.O.B. all that firepower?!
He does good work, doesn't he?
I've heard stories about you, Captain Amari, but none of them mentioned... how beautiful you are.
How cute. Your aim had better outdo your flattery, young man.
Aren't you a relic? A Siege Automaton E54... your kind left a grave wound on this world.
Come to think of it, I suppose we aren't so different.
You know, I haven't had any real competition at the range lately.
There are plenty of moving targets on the battlefield.
I'll... take that as a no.
Think I owe you a round, ma'am. Those names you gave me have turned out to be mighty fine recruits.
They were useless in my hands. You're the one who made something of them.
Even if I wish it were under nicer circumstances... it's good to have you back, Cap'n.
*chuckles* The world may be falling apart, Cole. But I know we can put it back together.
You always bring out the best in me.
Fighting battles at such a young age... I hope you remember to take time for yourself.
Sometimes. But I have so much to do.
You were truly fearsome in your prime.
Even past your prime, you are more lethal than ever.
Some people improve with age. Others... never quite learn to keep their mouths shut.
Ah, Captain Amari. Enjoying the world Overwatch left behind?
You remind me of an old friend. Someone else who thinks he's owed something for his pain.
And what sage advice did you have for him?
What's worth saying, if neither of you care to listen?
You're hard to keep a scope on, Genji. Always so unpredictable.
Don't be. It keeps me sharp.
I never knew you to be a show-off, Genji.
Only a fool wastes an opportunity.
I never asked my father his opinion of me. Now, he is beyond my reach.
I'm sure he was proud, even if he never said it.
I know that look. Mending an old wound?
I wronged someone dear to me. The path to redemption is... trying.
It's not pleasant. But you'll see it was worth it in the end.
Looking forward to crashin' your next funeral, "Captain."
Keep running your mouth like that, and I'm sure to outlive you.
I studied you in school. They said you were the best sniper in the world.
Like the sniper who shot out your eye?
It's possible. I've passed through Junkertown once or twice.
You're the one who kicked Red Ned in the wicker basket!
It's so hard to tell right from wrong. If only I had someone to... give me guidance.
Someone wise, and experienced! An... adoptive mother, if you will...
You remind me of myself when I was younger.
So, I'm trying to ask everybody this. What is your favorite animal?
Uh... yeah, I can see it!
How are you liking Samoa, Ana?
It'd be better in different company.
Oh, I see... you think we oughta ditch these other losers and get a glass of vaifala?
Is Fareeha getting enough rest between missions?
Ana, your daughter is more than capable of caring for herself.
She never napped when she was little. She was cranky all the time.
Does it bother you that you've taken as many lives as you've saved?
I don't mind killing monsters. But, go on. Keep pushing me.
Yet another stretch of cloudless skies and idyllic ocean views. Wonderful.
*sighs* Of course you would hate the beach.
Have you heard the reports? A masked vigilante has been running rampant in Cairo.
Well, let's hope they're swiftly dealt with.
So you're going with Cole... joining Overwatch.
What I want... never should have mattered to begin with.
You're still hiding. When are you coming back for good?
I'm trying, Fareeha. Please, be patient with me.
I've been patient for years. What's a little while longer?
Tell Jack to stop chasing me.
I know the old Gabriel is grateful.
Terrible. Every moment without you watching over me has been agony!
Ana, I'm so glad to have you back with Overwatch!
As am I, though I can't promise I'll stay around forever.
Then... *chuckles* I won't take a moment for granted.
Oh, Gibraltar... where has the time gone?
Do you remember that night? Dancing in the command center until dawn?
Ana... when we work together, we are unstoppable!
You don't have to shout, Reinhardt. I'm right here.
You answered Winston's Recall. Even after all you went through...
*sighs* If I am called, and I do not answer... what is left, Ana?
You are left, Reinhardt. And that is nothing to scoff at.
Ana, what has been going on in Egypt? It sounds... serious.
Just a few ghosts I'm laying to rest. It's nothing to worry about.
I always worry, Ana. But I trust you're doing what's right.
As long as you get into plenty.
I don't know why you're so happy to kill. I've never enjoyed it, even for the worst people.
Oh, always with the guilt and the regret. Don't you humans know how to have any fun?
How could we, with the likes of you around?
Coming back to Overwatch after all these years... does it feel like you're reliving the glory days?
"Glory days?" You sound just like Reinhardt.
I'll be taking that as a good thing, Captain.
He'd certainly like it if you did.
Seeing you and Fareeha out here in the thick of it... Wish I could have that with my mom.
Even when I was apart from my daughter, I never stopped loving her. I'm sure your mother feels the same.
*sniffs and chuckles* You really know how to tug at a girl's heartstrings. Don't cha, Captain?
The older I get, the faster the years go.
It's likely that time is passing at the same rate it always has. *chuckles* Barring relativistic effects, of course.
I liked you better when you were talking to yourself.
I'm a little surprised we both went the vigilante route.
What can I say? We've got good sense.
Remember the Vikosky kingpins? Three hundred meters downrange. You fired once, they both fell. Beautiful.
*sighs* That's not the word I would choose.
What? No lectures on how I'm fighting a losing battle, Ana?
Some of us know when to cut our losses, Jack.
How's Mirembe holding up after the Talon attack?
Not bad. She and her son have relocated somewhere safe.
None of us will be safe until we stop whoever took down Overwatch.
Hunt who you like, Jack. It's your mission now.
When I was in Peru, I found something you might want to look into.
I told you. My only mission now is to help anyone in Talon's sights.
There's a girl. I think they're going to add her to their list.
All right, I'll investigate. Thank you, Jack.
You can't take Talon down by yourself, Jack.
Maybe not. But then, I've always liked being the underdog.
You need to stop, Jack. This crusade is getting out of hand.
How many times have you told me that?
How many times have I been wrong?
Keep doing that, and I always will.
You like beaches, right, Ana? We should do a girls' trip to Tulum!
Mm... What's it going to cost me?
A peaceful reality is within our reach.
I wish I could believe that...
Retirement looks good on you, Ana.
Aren't we too old for flattery?
Hmph, we're still alive and kicking!
Still young at heart, I see.
Seems retirement couldn't keep a Lindholm away.
*chuckles* I was never good at taking time off anyway.
*chuckles* We've always had that in common, haven't we?
I don't know how you do it, Ana.
Stay still for hours, waiting for the perfect shot!
I don't know how you zip around without getting dizzy.
I happened upon some artifacts in an old necropolis. Would you care to look after them?
I should warn you, they might be cursed...
That's... a mask of Bastet! Judging by the brushwork, I'd guess it's over 3000 years old... and you're wearing it into battle?
I heard Talon failed another mission. Going soft?
Do not speak to me unless you wish to lose your other eye.
I'd still be the better shot.
Ana, may I still call you Captain?
Oh, Winston. That was a long time ago.
You'll always be Captain in my heart.
Anyone want to hear my favorite joke about the periodic table?
He says, if you have many aliases, why call yourself "Ana"?
These days, being myself is exciting enough.
Going to make the old woman get the door, hm?
I shouldn't waste borrowed time. Let's get a move on.
We cannot afford to hesitate. Believe me.
We've waited long enough. Time to go.
This will take some time. Keep them off us!
We need more time. Hold them off!
Focus up! Null Sector drop pods!
They're launching a full-scale attack. Dig in!
We have a Subjugator closing in!
They've damaged the objective. Secure our perimeter!
We have enemies on the objective!
We need to protect the cannon!
We have to protect the ferry!
We have company on the uplink!
Hold steady. I've salvaged missions in worse shape.
The objective can't take much more damage. Close up our defense!
The objective can't withstand much more. Concentrate!
The objective is compromised. Focus up!
The cannon won't last if we don't protect it.
We will not lose this cannon! Push them back!
Keep your heads. Saving this ferry is priority one.
The ferry's still in once piece. Let's keep it that way.
I'm not delivering a broken payload. Straighten up!
The payload won't last much longer...
Get it together, or we lose this uplink!
Let's defend the uplink while we still have it.
It's impaired. That will buy some time.
Eyes open. There's a Stalker nearby.
I hear a Stalker. Stay vigilant.
She has me! I need backup!
I prefer to keep my distance.
Don't fire on the Titan. Spend your ammo on enemies who will feel it.
I admire your spirit, but "spirit" won't bring down that Titan.
You of all people should know better than to fire on a Titan!
Even you can't pierce the Titan's armor, Fareeha. (after Pharah fires at a Titan)
A Vulture is moving on our position.
Someone, get me back into the fight!
We lost one. Keep it together!
We're down a soldier. Stick together.
Our teammate needs to be revived.
Mercy needs to be revived! (while Mercy is awaiting revival)
Someone revive Reinhardt! (while Reinhardt is awaiting revival)
Torbjörn needs to be revived! (while Torbjörn is awaiting revival)
Tracer is down, revive her! (while Tracer is awaiting revival)
It's up to me. Why am I not surprised?
Don't be so dramatic. You're fine. (after Reinhardt eliminates an enemy)
*in Arabic:* Do not give up now!
Fareeha, my daughter! (after Pharah is killed)
Jack... I was supposed to protect you. (after Soldier: 76 is killed)
Torbjörn... your luck ran out. (after Torbjörn is killed)
You're powered up! Destroy them! (self and target)
A new era will soon be upon us.
Humans are a blight and a weakness. They must not hinder us.
*garbled:* This place... I know this place. (on Watchpoint: Gibraltar)
Our enemies will regret their defiance.
Do not stand in our way!
You will not see our new world. Pity. (eliminating Omnic)
Overwatch will fall! (eliminating an Overwatch agent)
Witness the might of Null Sector.
All who oppose us will be annihilated.
You are of use to our cause.
My ultimate is ready. Are they? *laughs*
I will not leave a sunless sky unruled.
The high sun's power is mine. (putting Cassidy to sleep while he is using Deadeye)
You're powered up! Unmake them! (self and target)
I am not looking forward to fighting that snake... (on a nighttime map)
Bask in the light of Ra!
Witness the king of the gods!
May you find a new horizon.
Bow to the true sun god. (eliminating Divine Desperado Cassidy or Amaterasu Kiriko)
I rule all worlds. (eliminating Junker Queen or Vendetta)
You can't rival the Nile. (eliminating Wuyang)
You'll need more than that to set the sun.
Fierce as ever, Mau. (after Jetpack Cat eliminates an enemy)
I'm crying tears of joy. (after Pharah eliminates an enemy)
I will not leave a peaceful world behind.
Know your place! (after Reinhardt eliminates an enemy)
My command is law. You'd be wise to remember that.
The world has grown complacent... a mistake it will soon regret.
Mind yourself, Reinhardt. You're still of use to me. (with Reinhardt on the team)
I chose greatness. You chose failure.
Those bright eyes are blind to the truth.
I could be sunning in Lagos right now. *scoff* And where am I instead?
*chuckles* Reinhardt, why don't you give it a try? (with Reinhardt on the team)
I hate to work on vacation... (Samoa is mistakenly excluded)
Hm... How far is it to Malibu?
Let's hurry this along. There's a beach in Crete with my name on it.
I've always been a good shot.
These people moved past the Crisis so quickly. I envy that.
When was my last trip to Copacabana? Mm, too long ago...
We need to clear the area!
That was closer than I like.
Sometimes, I still feel that rush.
We need to group up before we can continue.
I never did collect my pension.
Get in there, I'll keep you patched up.
I will take care of you.
This will only hurt for a minute.
Never stop fighting for what you believe in.
There's nothing I haven't seen before. Stick together. We will complete our mission.
Stick to the plan, and if you get into trouble, I'll bail you out.
Use your heads out there. We'll get through this.
Look after yourselves out there. I'll get us home safe.
I'll be watching your backs, but be careful out there.
I will get us home safe.
I will bring you home safe.
Huh, I've come back from worse.
I wasn't cut out for retirement, anyways.
I'll rest when the fighting is done.
I'm not ready to hang it up.
It'll take more than that to keep me out of the fight!
Old soldiers are hard to kill.
This is much better than a cabana on the beach.
You're not getting rid of me that easily.
One's true worth is only known through trial.
